question: In 2024, the Royal Australian Air Force debuted its combat aircraft in India during Exercise Tarang Shakti at which location?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Air Force Station, Jodhpur**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Royal Australian Air Force (RAAF) debuted its combat aircraft in India at Air Force Station Jodhpur** during Exercise Tarang Shakti 2024. 
 
• The exercise** took place from August 30 to September 13, 2024. **
 
• The** RAAF sent three EA-18G Growler aircraft **and 120 personnel. 
 
• The exercise was the** first time the RAAF deployed combat aircraft to India. **
 
• The** exercise was part of a two-phase event, w**ith the first phase taking place at Sulur Air Force Station in Tamil Nadu. 
 
• The exercise** was an opportunity for the RAAF to showcase its advanced capabilities and support regional allies. **
